Name: Ramah in Asher
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Ramyah, in Asher's allotment
Description: A town named on the border of Asher's allotment, distinct from the Ramah of Benjamin and the Ramah of Naphtali.
BiblicalSignificance: Ramah in Asher is one of the border towns that fixed the shape of Asher's inheritance.
